scientific_integrity: The analytic all-size proof is supplied; exact finite checks are corroboration only. The Gaussian covariance/resistance identity is established background and is not claimed as new. Full independent verification and exhaustive historical priority assessment have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite mean-zero scalar harmonic rings at unit temperature, exactly two positive stiffness values, fixed inventory, stationary mean-square width only. General multiset, multidimensional, nonlinear and relaxation claims are not made. Closely related cyclic-point-energy optimization principles may yield overlapping implications in older literature.
title: Exact balanced-versus-clustered roughness law for a two-stiffness harmonic ring
